requests.outputText: The sky is blue because it is a reflection of the sunlight that falls on Earth. requests.text:
Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants, algae and some bacteria turn light into chemical energy. In the chloroplasts, chlorophyll absorbs mostly red and blue light. That energy splits water molecules, releasing oxygen as a by-product, and is stored for a short time in two carrier molecules, ATP and NADPH. In the second stage, the Calvin cycle, the plant uses those carriers to fix carbon dioxide from the air into three-carbon sugars, which it then builds into glucose, starch and cellulose. Almost all the oxygen in the atmosphere and most of the energy in food chains come from this process.

Summarise this paragraph in one sentence.
requests.outputText: Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants, algae, and some bacteria convert light energy into chemical energy, releasing oxygen as a byproduct and using it for energy and growth.
